items.title: Louis Keppard Interview, 1957-08-04
items.q: I played alto with him... Henry Martin, was playing kilo drum... that's in the brass band

ctx.x: yeah, I played alto with him, the brass band, was Black Benny, was playing bass drum, and Henry Martin, was playing kilo drum, Zeb was playing clarinet, that's in the brass band, who's the clarinet? Zeb,
